summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Titan Mining Corporation attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 earnings and operational updates. It covers zinc production, revenue growth, graphite and germanium developments, and financial metrics. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is discussed. The filing is a routine quarterly business update for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
